## What managing Streeterville takes.

### Institutional scale
Streeterville towers routinely run hundreds of units with engineers, door staff, and multi-elevator banks. Our financial reporting and staffing coordination are built for that scale, and hold up to financially sophisticated boards.

### Life-safety and facade compliance
Older residential high-rises here fall under Chicago's life-safety evaluation requirements and the exterior-wall critical-examination cycle. We keep both on visible, board-approved compliance calendars.

### Mixed-use towers
Buildings near Michigan Avenue often stack residences above hotels, retail, and parking. We administer shared-facility and reciprocal-easement cost allocations so the association pays its fair share and nothing more.

## Streeterville boards ask us first.

### Does CenterPoint manage large high-rise associations in Streeterville?
Yes. High-rise condominium management is a core CenterPoint practice: building staff coordination, elevator and mechanical contracts, facade and life-safety compliance, and reserve planning for major systems, with 24/7 live emergency response behind it.

### How do you handle towers shared with hotels or commercial space?
Many Streeterville buildings operate under reciprocal easement or shared-facilities agreements with hotel, retail, or parking components. We administer those cost allocations, audit shared expenses, and represent the association's interests in operator meetings.

### Does CenterPoint manage associations in Streeterville?
Yes. CenterPoint Association Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Streeterville, Chicago (ZIP 60611). Every association gets a dedicated manager, monthly financial reporting, and board support grounded in Illinois association law.

### How much does association management cost in Streeterville?
Management starts at $20 per unit per month, quoted as a flat monthly fee based on your association's size, building systems, financial complexity, and service scope. It is never a percentage of your budget. See [pricing](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/pricing) for what drives the fee.

### How does a Streeterville association switch to CenterPoint?
Plan on a managed 30 to 60 day transition after your board gives notice under its current contract. We retrieve records from the outgoing manager, set up banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open board and resident access.
